d70aec731600406bd20b5c3b965b8ee2.overview: In Victorian England, a bored young girl dreams that she has entered a fantasy world called Wonderland, populated by even more fantastic characters.
d70aec731600406bd20b5c3b965b8ee2.tagline: The Entertainment Miracle of All Times!

d723cdddf94ebfe38e6ae1363d241502.overview: Madeleine's middle-class family cannot understand why she puts off marrying a respectable young man, as they know nothing about her long-term affair with a Frenchman.
d723cdddf94ebfe38e6ae1363d241502.tagline: Here are the virile, violent facts that caused the most famous jury verdict in history...

d72a9789ad5ac224d8d9fb43f357e42f.overview: A man and a woman meet in the ruins of post-war Poland. With vastly different backgrounds and temperaments, they are fatally mismatched and yet drawn to each other.

d7386ad57592e9d9c5db0a3da2fcb9e9.overview: A cinematic odyssey featuring never-before-seen footage exploring David Bowie's creative and musical journey.

d743a2705237d847d89fc54757a6ee45.overview: Brother and sister Enrique and Rosa flee persecution at home in Guatemala and journey north, through Mexico and on to the United States, with the dream of starting a new life.

d74718018a9f36768b29139463563a36.overview: Follows the exploits of young Kay Harker, who finds himself drawn into a world of magic and danger when he encounters an old Punch and Judy man.

d74db8a445e02c91cdb44d5048c6fb3b.overview: A young couple, living in a campus apartment complex, are repeatedly harassed by an eccentric plumber, who subjects them to a series of bizarre mind games while making unnecessary repairs to their bathroom.
d74db8a445e02c91cdb44d5048c6fb3b.tagline: When your waterworks come back to haunt you!

d754fead8860de1649092f8e47160bfd.overview: An account of the days of First Lady, Jacqueline Kennedy, in the immediate aftermath of John F. Kennedy's assassination in 1963.

d775b9078e67442ab68b5ada7e4f647a.overview: The family of a wealthy businessman gather to celebrate his 60th birthday. During the course of the party, his eldest son presents a speech that reveals a devastating secret that turns the night into a battle of truth and denial.

d78a212a7a94d5814870d4bff58588d1.overview: In this film based on a Neil Simon play, newlyweds Corie, a free spirit, and Paul Bratter, an uptight lawyer, share a sixth-floor apartment in Greenwich Village. Soon after their marriage, Corie tries to find a companion for mother, Ethel, who is now alone, and sets up Ethel with neighbor Victor. Inappropriate behavior on a double date causes conflict, and the young couple considers divorce.
d78a212a7a94d5814870d4bff58588d1.tagline: Broadway's barest, rarest, unsquarest love play.

d7a29d70b21f6d48ee4dd17bab888f80.overview: Edie Bouvier Beale and her mother, Edith, two aging, eccentric relatives of Jackie Kennedy Onassis, are the sole inhabitants of a Long Island estate. The women reveal themselves to be misfits with outsized, engaging personalities. Much of the conversation is centered on their pasts, as mother and daughter now rarely leave home.
d7a29d70b21f6d48ee4dd17bab888f80.tagline: She was the girl who had everything - Money, good looks and social position. Her mother - a classic Bouvier beauty. Now they are living amongst the souvenirs of their lives. In Grey Gardens. This is their story. A love story. Sort of.

d7e27d3338fce7ae200ce596195bc301.overview: Thousands of birds flock into a seaside town and terrorize the residents in a series of deadly attacks.
d7e27d3338fce7ae200ce596195bc301.tagline: ...and remember, the next scream you hear may be your own!

d7f0d47c5255d42cda4ab6d65928f743.overview: A middle-aged couple suspects foul play when their neighbor's wife suddenly drops dead.
